rows.quote: This study utilizes a nested case-cohort design from the UK Biobank (UKB), integrating proteomics, genome-wide association studies (GWAS), and single-cell RNA sequencing data from the GEO database to systematically evaluate proteins associated with RA risk and identify novel therapeutic targets.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rule C): the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by a described procedure (a nested case-cohort design, followed by Cox analysis of proteomic data from 706 RA patients and 1410 controls) and not by a number of participants alone; no dictionary row is such an analysis.

Step 4 (rule D): the abstract names 'the UKB-PPP dataset' alone; the 706 patients and 1410 controls describe the Cox analysis, not the pQTL release, and no citation, subcohort or release-defining sample size separates the four UKB-PPP rows.
